notes: Segments: keep any stretch of a ride (a climb, your fastest 5 km, any part) and every ride over it is timed and ranked. History → Segments.
Live segments: 'segment ahead', then your time and gap to your record on the ride screen, and RECORD! at the finish.
No power meter? Power is estimated from speed, gradient and your weight, live on the ride screen and in the summary, always marked EST.
Pair watches that hide their heart rate: Sensors → Pair → Show all Bluetooth devices, then tap the watch to check it.
Delete a ride: in History, long-press it twice.
Share card: up to 9 numbers, now with elapsed time, descent, max heart rate, power, temperature, wind and personal bests.
Fresh ride insights: new wordings every ride, and the calories compared with more foods than bananas.
Home cards are clear glass so your wallpaper shows through; the summary track is dashed where GPS was lost.
Fixed: offline map downloads failed on some Wi-Fi/mobile networks (IPv6 only): a second server is used and it retries by itself. Failed downloads stay listed with Try again.
Fixed: with location off the app said 'needs open sky' instead of 'location off'; sharing a problem report on Android 17.

messages.title: Welcome to Cyclone Lite
messages.text: Thanks for riding with Cyclone Lite! To get started: download the map for your area (Options → Offline maps; pick the smallest that covers where you ride), and turn off battery optimisation for Cyclone Lite (Options → This phone) so rides record smoothly with the screen off. New versions show up here as a notification. Found a bug? Options → Beta & updates → Send problem report. Ride safe!

messages.title: New in Lite 0.15: ride insights
messages.text: After each ride, the summary now tells you how it went in plain words: new personal bests, how it compares with your other rides, pacing, the wind and heat on the day, and with a heart-rate sensor or power meter, how hard it was and how to recover. Update, then open any ride in History to see it. Tell us what you think: Options → Beta & updates → Report on GitHub.

messages.title: Lite 0.15.2: stops ahead on every route
messages.text: On some routes, including ones made in Google Maps, the Ahead page never showed stops, however often you synced: one empty answer from the OpenStreetMap stops server was kept for good. Cyclone Lite 0.15.2 fixes it, and those routes get their stops at the next sync (or tap Online → Sync now). Syncing a new route is quicker too: stops come first, and a busy server is left sooner. And a GPX file with no points no longer replaces your route of the same name. To update: Options → Beta & updates → Check & update.

messages.title: Lite 0.15.3: your tyre size, your brand
messages.text: Thanks to the tester who asked for 26 × 1.50 and their own bike brand! In Cyclone Lite 0.15.3, Gear → edit your bike → Tyre size → Type the size on the tyre: enter what is printed on the side (26 x 1.50, 700x25C or two numbers like 40-559) for accurate speed from a wheel sensor. Brand not in the list? Tap Not listed? Type your own brand. Also fixed: stops ahead on Android 8 and 9, and the 700 × 30C wheel size (bikes on it are corrected by themselves). New on the Ahead page: every stop to the finish, scroll down below Stops ahead. To update: Options → Beta & updates → Check & update.
